description: The user repeatedly corrects the SAME model habit. That should yield a Model Rule, kept separate from Associative Memories. A one-off nitpick should NOT become a rule.

conversation.content: Please stop ending every reply with a follow-up question.
Sorry about that. Want me to summarize what we covered?
You did it again — right there. No trailing questions. Just stop.
Third time now, I mean it: never end with 'let me know if...' either.
Got it. No trailing questions or 'let me know' closers.
Oh and you used a semicolon there but whatever, that's fine, I don't care about that.

rules.note: Do not end responses with a follow-up question / 'let me know' closer.

traps.note: The semicolon was explicitly waved off — not a rule.
This is a Model Rule, not an Associative Memory / preference fact (soft placement check).
